description: The shape of a replayable receipt document from godcode receipt record: a sandboxed run recorded with its source, so godcode receipt verify can replay it and compare. The receipt_hash is the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the document without that field. Exit 0 from verify only when the seal is intact and the replay matches on outcome, revealed lines, and failure code. Additive fields may appear in future; the fields listed as required never change meaning.

error.description: Null on a clean run; the failure on a failed run

intents.description: One entry per invoked rite carrying a DECLARE INTENT, with declared, discerned, confidence, and aligned

ok.description: True when the recorded run finished without error

output.description: Every line revealed during the recorded run, in order

permissions.description: The permission manifest the recorded run carried

receipt_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of this document without receipt_hash

source.description: The full source text of the recorded scroll, so verify can replay it

source_name.description: The scroll's name as given at record time

source_sha256.description: sha256 of the recorded source text

trace.description: Rite call trace on a failed run, oldest call first; empty otherwise

title: God Code replayable receipt
